description: This source file defines the 'Handling' class, a model extension for calculating additional handling fees within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It adds handling fee totals, applies taxes if configured, and updates total costs accordingly.

classes.name: Handling
classes.description: A model class responsible for adding handling fee totals, including tax considerations, into the overall order total calculation.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds the handling fee to the totals array if the order subtotal exceeds the configured threshold. Also applies applicable taxes and updates the total amount.
